correctness.rationale: The equality classification follows from the source's exact product formula and its central-element factorization. After decomposition into trivial-center factors, every factor contributes degree 2/|H_i|; equality 2/3 forces one size-3 factor and all other factors to have size 2. The converse follows by multiplicativity.
